  • It has been revealed that unraveled for Daybreak is the next chapter in the ongoing story of Planarcadia, with the Astra Express Crew now invited to a fan fest inspired by their own past journeys.
  • In a recent development, as everyone’s eyes is fixated on the grand Star Rail Fest, the Phantasmoon Games continue to be in full swing, as does the war with the Supplicants.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

A new Honkai: Star Rail Special Program has concluded, which means some fresh news about the game’s upcoming major upgrade. Version 4.1, unveiled today as Unraveled for Daybreak, is the action RPG’s next moment, kicking off on March 25.

It has been revealed that unraveled for Daybreak is the next chapter in the ongoing story of Planarcadia, with the Astra Express Crew now invited to a fan fest inspired by their own past journeys. The aptly named Star Rail Fest is ostensibly hosted to allow more of the citizens of Arcadia to experience the Trailblaze.

In a recent development, as everyone’s eyes is fixated on the grand Star Rail Fest, the Phantasmoon Games continue to be in full swing, as does the war with the Supplicants. Star Rail Fest is, however, the big focus of this patch, in case it wasn't obvious.

In a recent development, the event is made up of three large-scale zones, each themed around past excursions of the Astral Express. You’ll get to explore the Belobog Zone, Xianzhou Luofu Zone, and Penacony Zone. Later on, you’ll also be able to visit Pearluxe Tower, the headquarters of Pearluxe Corp.

Each area will feature its own attractions, such as the balloon figures of Supreme Guardian Cocolia and the Destruction Engine, the duel against the Lord Ravager Phantylia at Scalegorge Waterscape, and the Pearluxe Tower’s Alloy King Pom-Pom model.

The hot new arrival is bumbling noirish detective Ashveil whom we've met in Version 4.0, and who becomes a playable character with this update. Ashveil is a 5-Star Lightning-Type character, on the Path of The Hunt. You’ll be able to pull for him throughout 4.1's runtime, which is slightly reduced at four weeks instead of the usual six, in order to rebalance the schedule after the extra-long Version 3.8.

According to recent reports, in combat, Ashveil is capable of increasing Crit Damage of all allies. He can also mark an enemy as Bait, which reduces the Defence of all enemies on the field so long as this tag holds. If Ashveil uses his Skill on the baited target, he will deal extra Damage and regain Skill Points for the team.

Ashveil can bully that baited target even further by launching Hounding Pursuit. If any of his teammates attacks the Bait, he can further deliver a follow-up attack that gradually accumulates Gluttony for as long as he’s in combat. Gluttony can later be consumed to boost follow-up attack damage.

If he lands a kill, Ashveil continues to deal damage to the next enemy he attacks. That buff is transferred if that enemy is killed. Even in map exploration, Ashveil can be deadly, capable of inflicting Stunned upon enemies within a specific range.

Returning characters this patch will be Hyacine in the first half, and Boothill in the second half. Once again, due to the reduced runtime, their banner reruns will be slightly shorter than normal, at just two weeks each instead of three — so be sure to take that into account if you're planning on pulling for either of them.

Version 4.1 also adds the Wispae War Saga, a upcoming activity where you can practice your leadership skills by commanding different types of Wispae Soldiers in the Graphia Academy. You can upgrade each one, use spell cards to alter their effects, and later face other champions. You ultimately want to play this to unlock new Wispae Companions, not to mention complete the challenges within.

October was another action-packed month for 2026, with Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 dropping on Switch 2, and other titles such as Nintendo Switch Sports Resort & Final Fantasy Resonance also releasing.

The charts for the US market are now in, revealing the "projected top 10 best-selling video games" of the month. The Call of Duty series has also hit its 19th consecutive year as the best-selling game in its debut month. Here's the rundown via Circana's senior director and video game industry adviser Mat Piscatella. No sales figures are provided.

"October 2026 U.S. Video Game Market Highlights Thread from Circana - Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 was the best-selling game of October, marking the 19th consecutive year that a Call of Duty franchise release has been the best-selling game of its debut month.".

Sources indicate that circana has also shared an enhancement on the "projected top 10 best-selling video games" of 2026 so far in the US. Call of Duty: Black Ops II is in sixth on this chart. Meanwhile, Nintendo's Switch title Tomodachi Life: Living the Dream remains in 8th place. The same game has already sold more than eight million units globally (approx 8.81 million) since launching in April.

Recent findings suggest that piscatella also notes how Switch 2 hardware led in "unit and dollar sales" during October and 2026 year-to-date. Nintendo's "limited edition" Zelda 40th anniversary Switch 2 Pro Controller also led the month in "accessory dollar sales". Again, no sales figures were provided.

According to recent reports, and that's it for October 2026! November will reveal how Zelda: Ocarina of Time and GTA 6 have performed. Earlier this week, prior to the launch of GTA 6, it was revealed the Ocarina remake was crowned the best-selling physical game of 2026 in the US.

If you want to find out more about Call of Duty's return to Nintendo platforms, you can check out our Switch 2 review of Modern Warfare.

It has been revealed that did you purchase any games in October? Let us know in the comments.
